decision: Which combinations get a new backtest
options: A: all 6 HDD combinations / B: Region only (3) / C: only the Boon slice (Enterprise Region + Forest)
recommendation: A if compute allows; otherwise C then expand

decision: Rolling origin cadence for the new runs
options: A: monthly like the current 12 origins / B: fewer origins to cut compute / C: match the number of months of actuals per scenario
recommendation: C; Basilisk only has 5 months so forcing 12 would invent origins

options: A: run everything / B: run the cheap 12 models first and add the 3 neural ones later / C: reduce the key universe
recommendation: B; FNAR-V2 SMLP-TCN and NLIN-DLIN_FIXED dominate the cost

decision: What the Viewer shows while a combination has no backtest
options: A: hide the combination / B: show it disabled with an explicit reason / C: block the whole page
recommendation: B; consistent with the honesty rules already applied

options: A: remove from the Viewer metric list / B: show it disabled with the reason
recommendation: A for the metric list plus a note; it is forecast-only and belongs on the Forecast page

options: A: recompute is_selected_champion per combination / B: copy the current champion
recommendation: A; the champion is scenario dependent and copying it would be an invention

decision: Backfill labels on the existing 204300 rows
options: A: tag as HDD - EDB / Enterprise / Region / B: regenerate them
recommendation: A; verified by a 96.6 percent exact actual-value match

options: A: CSV in data/processed / B: a table in the DuckDB store / C: both
recommendation: C; CSV as the immutable record and DuckDB as what Shiny reads

decision: Six Enterprise Region keys have no backtest
options: A: top them up / B: leave the combination at 39 of 45
recommendation: A; otherwise the key dropdown silently drops 6 keys

decision: Horizon control stays in the Viewer
recommendation: A; horizon is the backtest lead time and is the reason the page exists
